```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><title>Shop Page</title><script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Product\",\"name\":\"Widget\",\"price\":\"9.99\"}</script><script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"BreadcrumbList\",\"itemListElement\":[{\"@type\":\"ListItem\",\"position\":1,\"name\":\"Home\"}]}</script></head><body><h1>Widget</h1><p>A great widget for all purposes.</p></body></html>", options: _options)
```
